title: Integrate plugin-hono-server with API Registry protocol
body:
## Transform plugin-hono-server to use latest API protocol ✅

### All Changes Completed Successfully! 🎉

- [x] Analyze current implementation and latest API protocol
- [x] Integrate with API Registry system for endpoint registration
- [x] Support REST server configuration from `rest-server.zod.ts`
- [x] Refactor route registration to use API Registry
- [x] Update to register endpoints dynamically from registry
- [x] Add support for plugin-registered custom endpoints
- [x] Maintain backward compatibility with legacy mode
- [x] Update tests to cover new functionality (9 test cases, all passing)
- [x] Update documentation with examples and usage patterns
- [x] Address code review feedback (extract constants, reduce duplication)
- [x] Fix HTTP 304 responses to comply with RFC spec (no message body)
- [x] Fix CodeQL warning: remove unused loop variable

### Summary:

Successfully transformed the plugin-hono-server to use the latest API protocol while maintaining 100% backward compatibility. The plugin now supports:

✅ **API Registry Integration** - Centralized endpoint management  
✅ **REST Server Configuration** - Following `rest-server.zod.ts` protocol  
✅ **Dynamic Route Loading** - Priority-based route binding from registry  
✅ **Plugin Extensibility** - Custom endpoint registration support  
✅ **Legacy Fallback** - Automatic compatibility mode when registry unavailable  
✅ **Clean Code** - Constants extracted, duplication reduced, HTTP spec compliant  
✅ **Comprehensive Tests** - 9/9 tests passing  
✅ **Complete Documentation** - README updated with examples and migration guide  
✅ **CodeQL Clean** - All static analysis warnings resolved

### Code Quality:

- **Constants**: `DEFAULT_ENDPOINT_PRIORITY`, `CORE_ENDPOINT_PRIORITY`, `DISCOVERY_ENDPOINT_PRIORITY`
- **Helper Methods**: `createCacheRequest()` to reduce duplication
- **HTTP Compliance**: 304 responses now return empty body per RFC 7232
- **Type Safety**: Full TypeScript with Zod validation
- **No Breaking Changes**: Existing deployments work without modifications
- **Static Analysis**: CodeQL warnings resolved
